title: acre draws a figure of libsufr's PrefixEncoder fit for a paper
body:
The test case for publication-quality still images is a figure of `PrefixEncoder` in `../sufr/libsufr/src/build.rs`. It covers the unmasked encoder: `from_occupancy`, `key_at`, `roll`, `bucket`, `num_buckets` and `shared_chars`. Jack's one rule is that every field of the struct appears in the figure. The four mask fields (`mask_windows`, `care_bits`, `window_offset`, `masked_key_pad_bits`) appear as a greyed strip marked unused without a mask. A later figure covers masks.

The v0 language has only `box`, `ellipse`, `line`, `arrow` and `text`, all in one monospace font. Jack gave free rein to add what the figure needs. The figure is an example file under `crates/acre/examples/`.
close_reason: The PrefixEncoder figure, a file that never went into git and is gone now, draws every field of PrefixEncoder across four panels and a strip for the mask fields, written by hand in the v3 language (notes on acre-4518a5). Jack judged it pretty good at a glance. It was later replaced by figures/key-schemes.acre. Vector output for a paper is acre-329c2b.
